description: Steady-state (S operator) via long-run average of the indicator reward. The steady-state probability of a set G equals the long-run average of 1_G (Baier & Katoen, Principles of Model Checking, Ch. 10; Puterman 1994), so IMPaCT computes it by reusing maxLRA with an indicator reward — and unlike PRISM's S (DTMC/CTMC only) it works robustly on interval MDPs.

measured.note: Live 2026-07-01. IMPaCT ss == Storm S=?[g]. PRISM S is DTMC/CTMC only; IMPaCT also does robust steady-state on interval MDPs.
